summary: Implemented every stub in imapclient/config.py (parse_config_file, get_config_defaults, create_client_from_config and the OAUTH2 token helper), imapclient/response_lexer.py (token reading for quoted strings, bracketed sections and words, plus TokenSource.current_literal) and imapclient/util.py (assert_imap_protocol, chunk, to_bytes, to_unicode). The last full-suite run stopped at collection on 13 modules because require_capability in imapclient/imapclient.py (another builder's file) is still a stub, so no tests ran; the 14 lexer tests pass when run against a stub package.
